# Membrane HLS Plugin v3.0.10 - Table of Contents

## Modules

- [Membrane.HLS.SegmentContentBuilder](https://membrane-hls-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.HLS.SegmentContentBuilder.md)
- [Membrane.HLS.SinkBin](https://membrane-hls-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.HLS.SinkBin.md): Bin responsible for receiving audio/video/text tracks, packaging them into CMAF/TS/AAC,
and writing playlists/segments via the provided storage.
- [Membrane.HLS.Source](https://membrane-hls-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.HLS.Source.md): Source element that reads a single media playlist and emits segment payloads.
- [Membrane.HLS.TrimAlign](https://membrane-hls-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.HLS.TrimAlign.md): Trims leading buffers so all input pads start at a common synchronization point.
